items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: And I did Gary Moore’s television show a couple of times here out of New York.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I did Art Linkletter, every time I went to the coast. I did Steve Allen when he was here in New York doing the Tonight Show before Johnny Carson and before Jack Parr. I did, and then when he went to the west coast I did his show out there, Steve Allen’s show out there as well. And Don O’Connor had a show out there, I did his show there, and I also did his show when he was being considered for the Tonight Show here in New York City. And I did local television shows, every city we went to. And I did…
